cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table; a starship galley and mess hall — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; an archery range of targets on a green field — holds her keepsake at chest height; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds a water bottle at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — seated on a chair
